tierBanner.title: You moved up from {fromTier} to {toTier}.
tierBanner.subtitle: New perks unlocked — check the Reps page.

welcome.title: You're in the crew.
welcome.body: Quick tour — so you know where everything lives. 4 screens, 30 seconds.

today.title: Today's session lives here.
today.body: Every morning you open Today. Tap the big "Start session →" card and you're off. The AI has already picked weights based on your 1RMs.

tabs.title: Bottom tab bar = the whole app.
tabs.body: Train = your programs. Crew = feed with PRs + form checks. Reps = earn and redeem. Me = profile, lift history and coach notes from Mikael.

formCheck.title: AI rates your technique.
formCheck.body: Tap "Form check with AI" inside a session. Record or upload — you get an answer within seconds. Mikael personally signs off within 24 hours.

reps.title: You get rewarded for showing up.
reps.body: +250 Reps per completed session. +100 per week in a program. Trade them for limited drops, custom-embroidered straps, and 1:1 time with Mikael.
